title: VMAFx run-result timeline, schema version 1
description: One versioned report format for a scoring run's provenance, per-frame scores, per-window statistics and events (VMAFx/vmafx#2452, RC5). Every object is closed (additionalProperties false) and the event vocabulary is fixed, so a change that adds a member or an event type takes a new schema version and a version-1 reader refuses a document it does not know by name; newer versions are additive supersets (never removed, renamed or retyped). The versioning model is ADR-3538. docs/api/run-result-timeline.md is the human reference. The skeleton pins the four sections' identities, not yet their full field contracts: provenance is the record of vmafx_context_provenance_json() (RC4 WP5, #2288; the authoritative field contract is the OpenAPI Provenance schema in api/openapi/vmafx-server-v1.yaml and the VmafxProvenance definition in core/api/vmafx.toml), and scoring_configuration is the option surface of #2258 (the ScoreOptions component of the same OpenAPI document). The C ABI writer/reader and the byte-equal write-read-write identity check land in the follow-up PRs of the same issue.

schema_version.description: The schema version the document was written against. 1 is the shape this file defines; a reader refuses an unknown version by name (#2452 acceptance).

frames.description: The per-frame series, in ascending time-key order: one entry per scored frame.

windows.description: Per-window statistics over ranges of the timeline: pooling and aggregation results.

events.description: The run's events, in ascending time-key order: alignment decisions, drops, repeats, freezes, switches and masked areas.

time_key.description: Where an entry sits on the timeline: at least one of the 0-based frame index, the presentation timestamp in nanoseconds from the run's zero, or the SMPTE-style timecode. A writer carries what the run knows - a frame score carries the frame index, a wall-clock event carries the timestamp - and an empty time key is refused.

frame_index.description: 0-based display order, the stream-metadata display_index of api/stream-metadata-fields.json.

timestamp_ns.description: Presentation timestamp in nanoseconds from the run's zero.

timecode.description: SMPTE-style HH:MM:SS or HH:MM:SS:FF timecode, optionally drop-frame with a semicolon before the frames. Hours, minutes and seconds are bounded; the frames field depends on the frame rate, so the reader checks it.

provenance.description: The provenance record of the context that produced the run: vmafx_context_provenance_json() (RC4 WP5, #2288) carries one key per field of VmafxProvenance and its models, features and annotations. The authoritative field contract is the OpenAPI Provenance schema (api/openapi/vmafx-server-v1.yaml) and the VmafxProvenance definition in core/api/vmafx.toml; this schema pins the identity anchor so a timeline stays attributable and leaves the field contract to that single source.

digest.description: The record's own digest: the digest member of VmafxProvenance, the SHA-256 of the record's canonical JSON (RFC 8785) without digest and elapsed_ns.

scoring_configuration.description: The scoring-option surface in effect for the run (#2258, WP8): the ScoreOptions component of the scoring group in api/openapi/vmafx-server-v1.yaml. The skeleton leaves the members to that single source.

frame_score.description: One scored frame: its time key and the scores written for it.

scores.description: Keys are feature names as the mounted models name them (for example vmaf, integer_adm2); values are that frame's numbers for the feature, null for a non-finite result as the CLI's JSON output writes it (core/src/output.cpp, json_write_frame_metric). A frame without scores is an empty object.

window_statistic.description: One statistic computed over a window of the timeline; the range is the half-open interval the writer knows (start inclusive, end exclusive when both ends are frame indices).

statistic.description: The statistic's name as the writer computes it (for example pooled, mean, worst_frame).

feature.description: The feature the statistic belongs to; omitted for a run-level statistic.

value.description: The computed value as a JSON number; null for a non-finite result, as the CLI's JSON output writes it (core/src/output.cpp, json_write_frame_metric).

event.description: One run event. A planted event without a time key is refused by name (#2452 acceptance).

type.description: alignment_decision records how streams were aligned; drop, repeat and freeze record frame-handling decisions; switch records a source or configuration switch mid-run; masked_area records a region excluded from scoring. The vocabulary grows additively under HISS-14.

detail.description: The event's facts as the writer reports them (for example the alignment offsets of an alignment_decision); the skeleton constrains nothing further.
